title: Joint logo lockup

location.series: IBM Logo Guidelines for Strategic Partners / Version 1.2 / copyright 2023

slide_intent: Define a narrow exception to normal separation so a joint announcement does not become an unauthorized joint identity.
strategic_value: Controlled lockup creation can let IBM announce partnerships while protecting the distinct roles of each brand.
demonstration: The page explains rare lockup use, shows a Red Hat/IBM lockup and a phone-page example with a link to a live reference.
practical_value: Use an IBM-created lockup only for its approved announcement context rather than treating it as a reusable offering identity.

content_islands.name: Exception guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the rarity, authorship and intended-use explanation in the left column.

content_islands.name: Lockup specimen
content_islands.spec: Center the Red Hat and IBM example in the middle column.

content_islands.name: Context example
content_islands.spec: Place the phone-page mockup and live-example link at right.

reference_purposes.Application: The page shows a joint lockup in a partnership announcement context.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Only IBM’s brand design team creates these assets; typical use is official joint announcements or partnership messaging, and the lockup is not an identity for a joint offering.

ingredient.name: Joint logo lockup
ingredient.role: Identify a specifically approved partnership announcement.
ingredient.application: Use the approved IBM-created artwork only within its intended announcement or partnership-message scope.
ingredient.scope: Rare exception in this partner guide. It does not authorize partners to make lockups or use one as the identity of a joint offering.
